sources.title: VLAlert: vision-language models for adaptive driver alerting
sources.snippet: Connections VLAlert applies the alerting problem that TriDrive 's driver-forecasting work targets from the world-model side, and its underlying event sources overlap with ADAS-TO. It sits in the lab's AI for mobility and Vehicle technologies threads.
